quests.title: Flavor of the Month

dialogue.t: Actually, I was planning to create a new dish based on the theme of the Windblume Festival — specifically, the "taste of the wind," and I'm currently preparing the necessary ingredients.
I commissioned Allan to help me go to Brightcrown Canyon to hunt for the freshest meat, but he hasn't returned yet, even after so long...
At this rate, my ingredients won't be fresh any longer. Could you help me go to Brightcrown Canyon to see what the situation's like?
Thanks! I'll let you try out my new dish once you return!
You're... Oh, I remember you. You were Xiangling's assistant, weren't you?
The memories of our culinary duel are still fresh in my mind.
I may have lost to her the last time, but this time, I will create a dish that has the "taste of the wind." Then I'll take it and ask her for a rematch!
I specially commissioned an adventurer to help me go to Dragonspine and obtain some Chilled Meat for this dish.
However, that adventurer — Schuster was his name, I think — has yet to return...
I've heard that Dragonspine is a very dangerous place. I wonder if he might have run into some trouble... Could you help me search for him?

dialogue.sit: I could do that, no problem.

dialogue.t: Thanks for your willingness to help. Make sure to light some fires to keep warm. Dragonspine is very cold, after all.
Why isn't he here yet...
This dish must evoke the Windblume Festival somehow...
I... I'm saved... Thank you so much.
I never thought that hunting one forest boar could get this hairy...

dialogue.sit: So, about the ingredients Brook wants...

dialogue.t: Oh, did Brook send you? Well, I do have the fresh Raw Meat she wants with me.
But I got careless while pursuing the boar and alerted the nearby monsters by mistake.
I got what I came for, but I was also surrounded by monsters...
Could you deliver the meat to Brook, Traveler? I need to go into the city and get my wounds treated at the Cathedral first...
*sigh* Ah, Draff is going to give me an earful again, I just know it...
Ah, you're back. Have you brought the Raw Meat with you?
Hmm, let me see... It does seem very fresh indeed. I think this will do. This meat will serve as our main ingredient... Now we just need some condiment that brings out the "taste of the wind"...
And when we're talking about that... We can only be speaking of "Dandelion Seeds."
Could you help me gather some Dandelion Seeds, Traveler?
Great! I'll leave it to you then. I'm going to prepare this meat in the meantime. Once you've gathered those Dandelion Seeds, just bring them straight back to me.
Do you have the Dandelion Seeds ready?
Thank you. Everything's ready now.
Ah, right. This is for you. Please consider it my thanks for your help.
But how should we prepare this food such that it will take up the "taste of the wind"?
Cooking, frying... Hmm, no, perhaps we should place the original flavor of the ingredients front and center, before scattering the Dandelion Seeds on once the dish is ready...
C—Cold... Why is it s—so cold...
C—Can someone... Can someone help me make a fire?
I've heard of Chilled Meat from other chefs as well. It's said that this type of meat has a unique flavor...
With these ingredients, I hope to make a dish that has some of that boom-shaka-laka...
I—I've been revived...
Y—You lit the fire... Th—Thank you, good-hearted traveler... Thank you...
A little warmer, that's for sure. I'll be fine... I was originally commissioned to come here to obtain some Chilled Meat...
I started out trying to look for some on the outskirts of Dragonspine, but as I walked, I misplaced my tinder — and that was before I also got lost by mistake...
If you hadn't arrived, I don't know what I would have done. You have my thanks.

dialogue.sit: So, what're you going to do about Brook's commission?

dialogue.t: Ah, so Brook sent you to find me, huh... *sigh* She must be beside herself right now, I imagine. But as it stands, I haven't the energy to travel all the way to give her this meat...
I'm sorry to ask this of you, Traveler, but could you help me deliver this Chilled Meat to her?
Thank you so much. As for me, I need to head down to that campsite in the foothills to get a bowl of hot soup...
Oh, you're back.
Oh, that's great! Wait... what about Schuster? He isn't in trouble, is he?
That's good. It's good that nothing serious happened. Once I've finished this dish, I should bring him a serving too, I think.
Speaking of that, this Chilled Meat really is different from normal meat. Perhaps a dish made from it really will have that certain... boom shaka-laka...
Still, I think that Dandelion Seeds will be needed to make something that bears the "taste of the wind."
But if we only do that, I feel that the result wouldn't be much different from any normal meat-based cuisine. We need some sort of decisive condiment.
Oh right! That's it! In truth, I've actually met Xiangling a few more times since our contest, and I heard about a dish known as Mushroom Slime Stew from her.
I've never used such strange and curious ingredients before... However, amazing dishes require equally unique ingredients.
Traveler, if I might trouble you again, could you help me look for some Slime Condensate and some Dandelion Seeds?
Great, I'm counting on you, then. I'll continue to ponder my recipe here.
Have you gotten the Slime Condensate and Dandelion Seeds ready?
Wonderful. Now we can truly begin. Thank you so much.
With this Chilled Meat and these two ingredients, I will surely be able to make a dish with true boom shaka-laka!
Ah, yes, here's something. Take it as thanks for your help.

quests.description: Brook from Springvale wants to create a new dish during the Windblume Festival.
